changelog:
Initial release: Enables one-to-many announcements with read receipts over the Pilot Protocol network.

- Broadcasts important updates to multiple recipients.
- Tracks delivery and confirmation via read receipts.
- Supports system announcements and policy changes.
- Requires running pilot-protocol and pilotctl binary.
- Not intended for casual chat or interactive discussions.
